name: tokensaver
description: Avoid reprocessing large stale conversations with local checks and bounded handoffs. Built by Freshwater Futures.

interface.longDescription: TokenSaver checks conversation size and age before model processing and saves a bounded local handoff when a large, stale turn is blocked. Checks run locally without network or model calls. Cache expiry is estimated; starting a fresh session is manual. Built by Freshwater Futures, combining behavioural science and AI engineering to help organisations turn AI inertia into AI impact.
